messages.subject: Editing an INLA graph object
parts:
Hi INLA Members,

I have created an INLA graph object from an adjacency matrix.

```
adj=diag(3)
adj[1,2]=adj[2,1]=1
inla.read.graph(adj)

```

Now I want to have the same structure to a set of new nodes say 4,5,6.

Is there any way to copy/edit the structure in inla?
